title: CR-004 Marble Afterimage
description: Source-backed V3.4 artifact transformation: translate the verified CR-001 adult fashion photograph into a contemporary museum-quality free-standing marble sculpture. Uses portrait_to_volumetric_sculpture + marble_sculpture + free_standing_statue. Symbolic reference roles only; binary reference packaging is out of PromptRecipe scope. Operator must supply the verified CR-001 PNG (SHA-256 0dcf8af6cac15441d5e728f98ac53314442984d3a27a5dd193effa2bac46f41e) as the image input at generation time. See docs/CR_004_MARBLE_AFTERIMAGE.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Transform the referenced adult fashion photograph into a contemporary museum-quality free-standing marble sculpture photographed in a restrained gallery. Preserve recognizable visual identity of the source adult figure, the distinguishing stance, and the gown's major draping silhouette, but translate flesh, hair, and cloth into coherent carved stone volume. The result must read as an actual sculptural object on a plinth—not a living person with a marble texture overlay, not an ancient excavated antiquity, and not a Classical Greek reconstruction. Keep one continuous marble material, physically plausible support and contact shadows, and quiet contemporary gallery lighting.
